The same package verifies drawing, undo/redo, input/result switching, reference underlay, Mask separation, model switching, restart recovery, and constrained narrow-window layout.
The evidence records the exact package identity and screenshots without exposing secrets or private paths.

evidence.environment: macOS arm64 packaged Electron candidate from eb60f2e, Electron 39.8.10, Chromium 142. Candidate app bundle: release/mac-arm64/CrossGen.app; app.asar SHA256 a4d71de5721a2bd550dacfd2afda44376cf82c96456e1e0d6e5de2e1dc535d39; main executable SHA256 183cf9370f7f2ae62c36aed06e21bed50366ac622f7b013bddeed1cd880889ea.

artifacts.description: Current eb60f2e macOS arm64 test package; DMG size 104000992 bytes SHA256 7868ababb81f05b10d46f6ec18c42f9a2a0009cc2f57af8a718badbf2c71cbc6, ZIP size 99746454 bytes SHA256 9cac8ce12a8df5400c0c021c380640b6fdefbf9289a4cba895bb66c697166f03.
Compact-sidebar layout screenshot from the eb60f2e test package; SHA256 2e2c996c6e7dc705d42289c2026dc69c0e2a181c6a8a5071760a6b70562bd1b3.

evidence.summary: The exact eb60f2e packaged candidate opened Sketch from the image-to-image reference area without adding a top-level mode, verified drawing, undo/redo/clear, underlay, save-and-use, restart recovery, mock generation, input/result switching, Sketch removal followed by ordinary reference Mask recovery, model switching, constrained viewports, and compact sidebar layout.

gates.title: Packaged Sketch feature-flag rollback
acceptanceCriteria: CROSSGEN_SKETCH_ENABLED=0 disables the Sketch entry and rejects new Sketch IPC, draft, request, and queue operations.
The same packaged app continues to support ordinary text-to-image, image-to-image, Mask, History, and Gallery workflows.
The evidence records the flag value, exact candidate, and observed ordinary-workflow recovery.

evidence.environment: macOS arm64 packaged Electron candidate from eb60f2e with CROSSGEN_SKETCH_ENABLED=0 and an isolated temporary user-data directory. No provider credential was used.
evidence.summary: With CROSSGEN_SKETCH_ENABLED=0, the renderer entry disappeared and Sketch asset/document IPC, Sketch draft, and Sketch queue requests were explicitly rejected, while ordinary text-to-image, image-to-image, Mask, History, Gallery, and Queue read surfaces remained available on the eb60f2e packaged candidate.

gates.title: AIHub real GPT Image 2.5 and Nano Banana 3 Sketch matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Only the approved AIHub aggregation API is used for real image calls.
GPT Image 2.5 and Nano Banana 3 Sketch workflows are exercised for composition, pose, reference handling, speed, quality, and failure recovery.
The evidence records redacted model, route, elapsed time, retry, output, and artifact metadata; no API key or private path is recorded.
Mock tests and provider success responses are not treated as a substitute for product-owner quality review.

evidence.environment: Approved AIHub aggregation API /models probe returned HTTP 200 from https://aihub.nowosoft.cn/v1 against the merged origin/main candidate. The configured key exposed gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image, and gpt-image-2; GPT Image 2.5, Sunburst, Flare, and Nano Banana 3 were not listed. Direct read-only probes returned model_not_found for each target. Credentials were loaded from the ignored local environment file and were not recorded.

artifacts.description: No-cost read-only probe recorded the available image model IDs and redacted direct target-model responses against the merged mainline; no image-generation request was made.

evidence.summary: Real AIHub Sketch quality and recovery matrix remains pending because the approved AIHub /models response on September 14, 2026 still does not expose GPT Image 2.5 or Nano Banana 3. Direct probes for gpt-image-2.5, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2.5-flare, and nano-banana-3 returned model_not_found. No mock, legacy model, or compatible model is used as a substitute; human quality review remains required.
